test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT?

options.text: Food from the stomach passes into the small intestine
Complete digestion of carbohydrates, proteins and fats takes place in the small intestine
Saliva contains an enzyme called salivary lipase that breaks down starch into simple sugar
Food enters the stomach through the oesophagus (esophagus)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Saliva contains an enzyme called salivary lipase that breaks down starch into simple sugar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saliva **contains **special enzymes that help digest the starches in your food.**
 
• An enzyme called **amylase **in saliva breaks down** starches (complex carbohydrates) into sugars,** which your body can more easily absorb.
 
• Saliva also contains an enzyme called lingual lipase, which breaks down fats.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b905d7003d06f4639a74ccbd24f9cf2bdcff2761f7ec676a8d5b9d6de2e57d19.png] 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Nutrients
 Digestion occurs
 
 
 
 

 Carbohydrates
 Digestion begins in the mouth or buccal cavity with salivary amylase released during the process of chewing. 
 
 

 Fats
 Fat digestion happens when reaches the small intestine (Duodenum).
 
 

 Proteins
 In the stomach, chemical breakdown occurs in hydrochloric acid and enzymes called proteases, breaking it down into smaller chains of amino acids. 
 
 

 Vitamins
 The food along with vitamins is digested by stomach acid and then travels to the small intestine, where it is digested further. Bile is needed for the absorption of fat-soluble vitamin
 
 

 Minerals
 The bulk of mineral digestion occurs in the small intestine.
